parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable a hot standby cluster. Valid values:

on: Enables a hot standby cluster.

equal: Enables a peer cluster
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启热备集群。取值范围如下：

on：开启热备集群。
equal：开启对等集群
parameters.name: hot_standby_cluster

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

可通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看地域信息详情
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone for the hot standby storage cluster. Valid values:

auto (default): The system automatically selects a zone.

The default value is valid only when \`HotStandbyCluster\` is set to \`on\`. A specific zone is required when \`HotStandbyCluster\` is set to \`equal\`. For more information about zones, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html
parameters.help_zh:
存储热备集群的可用区。取值范围如下：

auto（默认）：自动选取。
HotStandbyCluster参数为on时可以用默认值， HotStandbyCluster参数为equal时必须用具体的可用区参数https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看可用区信息详情
